required_fixes: FIX-1 (cost counter integrity): Replace the fabricated parity cost counter with genuine operation counting. `execute_single_resource_staleness.py:272-281` sets base_cost=4 ('1+1+1+1') and adds `extra = traj_idx % 2` with the code comment 'To ensure within-family std>0, add trajectory-dependent offset'. Cost is therefore not a count of performed operations (every request performs identical operations; browser_steps=0). Honest counting yields constant 4 per request -> within-family cost std = 0 -> frozen V5 fails -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID under spec.json:decision_rule. Variance injected to pass the V5 std>0 gate is the same class of cost-vector manipulation (fabricated jitter/proxy) the honesty gates (V2/V3, prior n*3200 and f*6.0 failures) were designed to exclude. Either report the honest constant cost and accept V5 failure, or re-freeze a satisfiable gate; do not add post-hoc variance.

FIX-2 (M-RHO-SHUFFLED identity): Implement and report the metric exactly as frozen. prereg.md:84 defines `M-RHO-SHUFFLED = max |Pearson rho| between shuffled cost and outcome (1000 perms trajectory-grouped)`. Producer's metrics.json reports M-RHO-SHUFFLED=0.0578 which is the MEAN (provenance.json:notes admits 'mean |rho| not max |rho| ... mean 0.0578 used per spec ambiguous threshold'), while the producer's own M-RHO-SHUFFLED-MAX=0.2147 >= 0.20 violates the frozen gate under the prereg definition. Recompute max over 1000 trajectory-grouped permutations and report it as M-RHO-SHUFFLED; report mean and max separately with the frozen definition cited.

FIX-3 (V4 trajectory-grouped shuffle): `execute_single_resource_staleness.py:509-521` performs an independent per-request shuffle ('Simpler: shuffle cost vector randomly per permutation (independent shuffle)'), not the trajectory-grouped permutation required by spec.json V4 and prereg.md:100. Recompute the permutation null by shuffling whole trajectory blocks. (Auditor recomputation: trajectory-grouped max |rho| = 0.1514 < 0.20 passes; the 0.2147 max is an artifact of the deviant request-level shuffle. The point is to implement the frozen procedure, not to mine the favorable statistic.)

FIX-4 (NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY not executed): The control as frozen (spec.json:null_control; NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY in result.json) requires fresh resources with optional-field churn and null-valued fields, guard applied, false_accept <= 0.10. No such stimulus exists in raw_evidence/execution_results.json: all 120 fresh bodies have the identical key shape {email,id,name}, zero null-valued fields, zero churn-only fresh requests. Producer marks the control pass=true citing stable-family FP=0, which tests none of the defined noise patterns and cannot support 'guard does not conflate noise with staleness'. Generate and run the defined noise stimulus (or explicitly downgrade/rename the control).

FIX-5 (un-satisfiable decision rule): D2 (false_accept<=0.10 -> >=81 of 90 stales must be flagged, UNKNOWN >= 81/210 = 0.386) and D3 (UNKNOWN in [0.00,0.15]) are mutually exclusive at the frozen 90/210 stale prevalence; D4 (ECE<=0.15) is impossible under the frozen 0.9/0.5 confidence scheme (any correctly flagged stale contributes 0.5*(n_b/N); ECE >= 0.5*90/210 + 0.1*120/210 = 0.2714). SURVIVES was arithmetically impossible by construction, so the FALSIFIES outcome carries no discriminating information about the calibration hypothesis. Re-derive a satisfiable operating point (prevalence-aware UNKNOWN bound, per-class ECE, or selective-UNKNOWN policy) and re-freeze before any SURVIVES/FALSIFIES claim on calibration.

FIX-6 (control/spec inconsistencies): (a) B-NO-GUARD expected 'TN ~0' (spec.json:baselines) is incoherent with producer's own TN definition (fresh retained); observed TN=1.0 vs expected TN~0 yet pass=true. (b) prereg.md:50 promised per-trajectory caching from 3-5 pre-drift observations; code uses one global precomputed fresh template (execute_single_resource_staleness.py:194-209). (c) In family param_header_mutation both param_changed and csrf_changed are computed from client-side constructed values (code lines 298-302), not from server response content; detection in 1/3 families is client-internal self-comparison with no end-to-end HTTP staleness content. Disclose all three explicitly in the packet.

FIX-7 (packet outcome re-label): Given FIX-1..FIX-3, the frozen classification rule (spec.json:decision_rule: 'MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any honesty gate V3-V6 fails') yields MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not COMPLETE/FALSIFIES. Re-label result.json status/outcome accordingly and re-run the honesty chain before issuing any claim update for C-FRESHNESS.
validity_findings: VF-1 (cost counter fabricated; V2/V3/V5-cost fail under frozen text): The per-request cost is 4 on even-indexed trajectories and 5 on odd-indexed trajectories (confirmed in raw_evidence/cost_logs.json and execution_results.json; sum 940; within-family cost std 0.5 for drift families, 0.4714 for stable). Code comment states the offset exists 'To ensure within-family std>0'. The counter does not count operations (identical operations per request; no browser steps), so the V5 cost-std>0 gate is passed only by injected variance; honest counting gives std=0 -> frozen MEASUREMENT_INVALID. This is the same manipulation class (artificial variance in the cost vector) that V2/V3 were frozen to exclude.

VF-2 (M-RHO-SHUFFLED metric identity swap and non-frozen implementation): prereg.md:84 defines M-RHO-SHUFFLED as the MAX over 1000 trajectory-grouped permutations. Producer reports the MEAN (0.0578) under that identifier, while their own max is 0.2147 >= 0.20. Additionally the permutation is request-level, not trajectory-grouped (code comment 'Simpler: ... independent shuffle'). Auditor recomputation: request-level max 0.2147 (reproduces producer), trajectory-grouped max 0.1514 (< 0.20, gate passes if implemented as frozen). The frozen metric was neither computed nor reported; D9 cannot be certified either way from producer evidence.

VF-3 (NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY control stimulus absent; pass claim unsupported): No fresh request contains optional-field churn or null-valued fields; all fresh bodies have exactly {email,id,name}. The control's decisive stimulus was never generated. Producer's pass rests on stable-family FP=0 which does not test the frozen control definition. Consequently 'guard does not conflate noise with staleness' is untested; note the dom_drift family flags an added 'phone' field as stale (Jaccard 0.75 < 0.85), so the noise/staleness boundary is genuinely unresolved.

VF-4 (frozen decision rule is arithmetically unsatisfiable -> FALSIFIES is preordained): With 90/210 stale prevalence, D2 (FA<=0.10) forces >=81 stales flagged UNKNOWN -> UNKNOWN >= 0.386, contradicting D3 (<=0.15). D4 (ECE<=0.15) cannot hold under the frozen confidence scheme: every correctly flagged stale sits in bin [0.5,0.6) with |acc-conf|=0.5, giving ECE >= 0.5*(90/210) + 0.1*(120/210) = 0.2714. The producer's own validity_notes/report acknowledge this, yet the packet still labels the result a 'valid negative' (FALSIFIES). The D3/D4 failures are specification contradictions, not empirical falsification of the calibration hypothesis.

VF-5 (verification is tautological; V1 holds only procedurally): `_matches(required, resp_body)` is called with required=body constructed by the client from the same deterministic ground-truth rules that generated the request (code line 288). verified=True for 210/210 is guaranteed by construction and cannot fail; it verifies no learned or independent mechanism. Deterministic, but non-informative.

VF-6 (param_header_mutation family has no end-to-end detection content): Both param_changed (live vs cached param NAMES, from the client's own query_params dict) and csrf_changed (client variable `csrf`, not resp_csrf) are client-internal comparisons (code lines 296-302). The server response is never the source of the mutation signal in this family. The other two families use response-derived signals (body field set; ETag/Cache-Control). 1 of 3 families measures only client-side template drift against cache.

VF-7 (other minor validity caveats): (a) 304 exclusion is vacuous - the server never emits 304 (code lines 126-130), the client never sends If-None-Match; (b) the guard cache is a single global precomputed fresh template (code lines 194-209), not per-trajectory observed caching as prereg:50 describes; (c) cache_expiry family only fires on etag_changed AND max-age=0 - a content change with unchanged max-age=60 would be missed (untested real-world miss pattern); (d) bootstrap CIs are degenerate at ceiling ([1.0,1.0] / [0.0,0.0] / [0.4286,0.4286] / [0.2714,0.2714]) because detection and the injected cost/confidence structure are deterministic - disclosed by producer, reconfirmed by auditor 200-iteration spot check; the V5/V6 non-degeneracy gates were intended to catch this and are only 'passed' via the constructed confidence/parity variance (see VF-1).

VF-8 (bounded-positive content survives as observation, not as claim): The detection observations are real and recompute exactly: M-TN-SPIDER 1.0 (120/120), M-FALSE-ACCEPT-SPIDER 0.0 (0/90), per-family TN/TP 1.0 with Wilson lower 0.8865, Wilson TN lower 0.969, FA upper 0.0409, UNKNOWN 0.4286, ECE 0.2714, ablations B-JACCARD-ONLY FA 0.6667 / B-HEADER-ONLY FA 0.3333. These establish only that this deterministic drift-injection protocol is detected with a threshold-0.85 multi-channel guard on a locally-hosted synthetic flat-JSON site - a proof-of-concept, not a validated freshness capability, and not a calibrated operating point.

claim_ceiling: MAXIMUM JUSTIFIED CEILING (observation-only, no claim update authorized): (1) On the frozen locally-hosted synthetic single-resource site (stdlib http.server, 210 deterministic requests, 120 fresh / 90 stale, threshold 0.85, combined Jaccard+param/header+ETag/cache guard), the guard detects ALL injected deterministic drift: M-TN-SPIDER 1.0 (Wilson lower 0.969), M-FALSE-ACCEPT-SPIDER 0.0 (Wilson upper 0.0409), per-family TN/TP 1.0 (lower 0.8865), beating B-NO-GUARD (FA 1.0) and both ablations (FA 0.6667 / 0.3333). This is a bounded synthetic proof-of-concept for deterministic signal isolation only. (2) The frozen decision rule could NOT be satisfied by construction: D2 and D3 are mutually exclusive at 90/210 stale prevalence (FA<=0.10 forces UNKNOWN >= 0.386 > 0.15), and ECE<=0.15 is impossible under the frozen 0.9/0.5 confidence scheme (floor 0.2714). Hence 'FALSIFIES' conveys no discriminating information about the calibration hypothesis; the packet supports neither SURVIVES nor a scientific FALSIFICATION of C-FRESHNESS calibration, nor any upgrade of C-FRESHNESS (registry status HYPOTHESIS, codex/claim_state.json latest event MEASUREMENT_INVALID from EXP-PRODUCT-35936223443). (3) Honesty gates V3-V6 do not pass under the frozen text (fabricated cost variance; M-RHO-SHUFFLED as frozen = max over trajectory-grouped perms unreported, producer's own max under their deviant implementation 0.2147 >= 0.20), so the frozen classification is MEASUREMENT_INVALID, overriding the producer's FALSIFIES label. (4) Product consequence: no freshness-gating reuse authorization at this threshold/site/confidence scheme; calibrated abstention (UNKNOWN/ECE) remains unestablished; delta-repair and residual-novelty gates remain blocked. (5) NOT established and must not be assumed: any claim about real APIs/production SPA/correlated latent (session/permission) non-determinism, noise-vs-staleness discrimination (control unrun), or any calibrated operating point.
